Subject: Q3 grant program — status

Hey team, quick brain-dump before I log off. The reviewer panel is still short two people and we promised the board a shortlist by Sept 30, so that's getting tight. Also nobody has confirmed the cloud budget for the scoring pipeline — if that slips we can't run the automated pre-screen at all. One more thing: the data-sharing agreement with the partner uni hasn't been signed, legal flagged it weeks ago and it's just sitting there. Oh and the public announcement is already drafted and scheduled, which feels premature given the above.

— M.
